head_commit.message:
Harden L12/L13: refuse weaponized memory + Sybil-proof consensus

Two field-gap receipts, measured and fixed:

L12 EXCHANGE — memory as an injection vector (OWASP ASI06 at import).
import_lesson verified integrity+quality but never scanned the body, so a
malicious peer's hash-valid lesson carrying a prompt-injection/shell idiom
was imported verbatim and re-exposed by recall. Now every artifact body
string is run through inject_scan() (16 pure-regex idioms mirrored from
NEURAL_MESH's ContentValidator); weaponized lessons are REFUSED before any
write (journaled IMPORT_REFUSED_POISON). Measured: IMPORTED->reject,
poison persisted True->False, recall hits 1->0; legit lessons still import
(no false positives).

L13 CONSENSUS — Sybil-able. reach_consensus counted stores as votes and
trusted self-declared provenance, so 2 clones of ONE owner with fabricated
falsifiable provenance (conf 0.75) forced CONVERGED over 2 honest
higher-integrity stores (conf 0.55). Now quorum needs >=2 distinct owners
(small <=2-owner fleets still converge), and majority is by distinct
owners. Measured: CONVERGED(crisis)->DEADLOCK; attack forced truth
True->False. Harmless small-fleet truth-vs-dissent still CONVERGES
(regression-pinned).

- demo/ablate_l12_injection.py, demo/ablate_l13_sybil.py (pre/post)
- tests/test_poison_sybil_hardening.py (8 new regression tests)
- test_consensus_curriculum.py: believers carry distinct tenant identities
- docs/judge.md +2b receipts, README/AGENTS.md layer rows + counts
- Full suite: 142 passed (was 134), zero regressions
